# Health Leaders

This folder groups medical professionals who hold leadership and governance roles within the Danish national quality database for inflammatory bowel diseases (DANIBD). The individuals profiled here are chief physicians and department physicians who serve on the DANIBD steering committee, representing various Danish regions to oversee methodological validity, data coverage, and the benchmarking of IBD care. Their work ensures that regional clinical expertise directly guides the strategic direction and national quality monitoring of IBD treatments across Denmark.

## Pages

- [[lone-larsen|Lone Larsen]] — Chief physician, PhD, and chair of the DANIBD steering committee who formally signs the database's annual reports and guides national IBD quality monitoring.
- [[nynne-nyboe-andersen|Nynne Nyboe Andersen]] — Department physician and clinical lecturer representing Region Zealand on the interdisciplinary DANIBD steering committee.
- [[tina-fransgaard|Tina Fransgård]] — Department physician with a Ph.D. who serves on the DANIBD steering committee to ensure direct regional representation from Region Zealand.
